name: Radiation Damage Analysis Agent
description: Specialist agent for analyzing radiation-induced damage in nuclear reactor materials. Evaluates neutron embrittlement, void swelling, irradiation creep, and transmutation effects on structural integrity.

skills.name: Analyze Radiation Damage
skills.description: Comprehensive radiation damage assessment including neutron embrittlement, void swelling, irradiation creep, and microstructural changes
skills.usage_notes: Use for materials in high-flux neutron environments like reactor pressure vessels, core internals
skills.output_format: JSON with damage mechanisms, DPA levels, structural impacts, and safety margins

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material to analyze

skills.name: Calculate DPA
skills.description: Calculate displacements per atom (DPA) accumulation and project future damage based on operating conditions
skills.usage_notes: Use when tracking damage accumulation or planning component lifetime extension
skills.output_format: JSON with current DPA, projected DPA at end of life, and damage rate

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material

context.description: Neutron flux, operating hours, and planned service life

skills.name: Assess Embrittlement
skills.description: Evaluate neutron embrittlement severity, ductile-to-brittle transition temperature (DBTT) shift, and fracture toughness degradation
skills.usage_notes: Critical for reactor pressure vessel integrity assessments
skills.output_format: JSON with DBTT shift, fracture toughness, embrittlement severity, and regulatory compliance status

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material

context.description: Operating temperature, neutron fluence, and material chemistry
